attchmntText: Nath Bio-Genes (India) Limited has informed the Exchange about General Updates
voiceSummary: Nath Bio-Genes India Limited filed a presentation on unaudited financial results for the period ended 30th September 2026. For H1FY27, revenue increased 13% to INR 3,601 Mn from INR 3,199 Mn in H1FY26. Gross profit rose 13% to INR 1,922 Mn. EBITDA declined 11% to INR 410 Mn. Profit before tax after adjustment of exceptional item fell 16% to INR 365 Mn. Profit after tax excluding extraordinary items decreased 18% to INR 349 Mn. Earnings per share dropped to 18.38 from 22.31. Paddy contributed 37% of sales, cotton 26%, and bajra 13%.

attchmntText: Nath Bio-Genes (India) Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: Nath Bio-Genes India Limited board approved standalone and consolidated unaudited financial results for the quarter and half year ended 30th September 2026 on 14th November 2026. Standalone net profit for the quarter ended 30th September 2026 was Rs. 226.97 lakhs compared to Rs. 420.09 lakhs in the same period last year. For the half year ended 30th September 2026, standalone net profit was Rs. 3492.65 lakhs versus Rs. 4240.69 lakhs previously. Revenue from operations for the quarter was Rs. 3726.73 lakhs against Rs. 3977.07 lakhs last year. Total assets as of 30th September 2026 stood at Rs. 120465.73 lakhs. The limited review report by statutory auditors indicates no material misstatements. The meeting commenced at 02:00 p.m. and concluded at 05:00 p.m.

attchmntText: Nath Bio-Genes (India) Limited has informed the Exchange about General Updates
voiceSummary: Nath Bio-Genes India Limited will hold an earnings conference call on Monday, 16th November 2026 at 04:00 PM IST. The call covers Q2 and H1FY27 earnings. Hosted by Go India Advisors, participants include Managing Director Mr. Satish Kagliwal, Executive Vice President Dr. Devinder Khurana, Chief Financial Officer Mr. Amol Gupta, Sales Lead Mr. Harish Pandey, and Research Lead Mr. Venkatesh Kulkarni. Attendees are advised to pre-register to avoid wait time. Dial-in numbers are 086 3416 8887 and 086 4536 7331. Participants should dial in at least 5 to 10 minutes prior to the scheduled time.
